subject: Discrepancy: June billing lines + VAT reclassification request
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@helion.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discrepancy on June invoice and VAT treatment

Hi Olga,

Our accounts team noticed a duplicated consumption line on invoice #4872 for June and an unexpected VAT charge that Helion should not have been billed for (we are VAT-registered and should have been reverse-charged). I attached the invoice and a small export of the usage lines that show the duplicated tokens on 2025-06-21 (lines 118-121).

Can you confirm whether this is a billing system duplication or an ingestion/reporting issue? We need an adjusted invoice and a credit memo to reconcile against our June closed month — ideally before July 16 so we can include it in this month-end.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Finance
Helion AI
Attachment: Helion_Invoice_June_2025_4872.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: usage_export_202506.csv (csv)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@helion.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on June invoice and VAT treatment

Hi Elena — thanks for sending this over and sorry for the disruption. I received the invoice and CSV. I'm looping in Sean from finance and Marissa (your account lead) so we can investigate and expedite an adjustment.

Next steps:
- Sean: can you take a quick look at the attached invoice/usage export and confirm whether this is a duplicate charge on our billing pipeline or a post-processing error?
- Marissa: if this is an overcharge, we'll prepare a credit memo and an adjusted invoice. Elena, please confirm your VAT number so we can mark this as reverse-charge if applicable.

We aim to have a provisional answer within 48 hours and a final credit memo within 5 business days.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena@helion.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Helion AI Billing <billing@helion.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 08:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on June invoice and VAT treatment

Thanks, Olga. VAT number is: IT00788900321.

We also pulled the Helion-side logs and it looks like the usage burst on 2025-06-21 was captured twice in the token aggregation pipeline (two identical entries, same timestamps and request IDs). We estimate the overcharge (net of VAT) to be approximately USD 4,000–4,500.

I've re-attached the invoice and the CSV for convenience. Please let me know if you need a signed statement from our accountant — we would prefer a credit memo and adjusted invoice rather than a refund.

Elena
Attachment: Helion_Invoice_June_2025_4872.pdf
Attachment: usage_export_202506.csv

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 15:44:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on June invoice and VAT treatment

Team,

I reviewed the invoice and the usage export. Root cause: a retry loop in one of our ingestion workers caused duplicate aggregation records for the 2025-06-21 burst (request IDs ending in -7f8c). The duplicate added ~72,000 tokens that were billed twice.

Proposed remediation:
- Issue a credit memo for USD 4,320 (net).
- Issue an adjusted invoice (4872 v2) removing the duplicated lines and reclassifying VAT as reverse-charge (0% VAT on the customer-facing invoice).
- Apply the credit to Helion's outstanding balance; if they prefer a refund we can do that but they asked for a credit memo.
- Create a rollback fix for the aggregation worker; Dylan will open a postmortem ticket.

I'll draft the credit memo and adjusted invoice for signatures; need Marissa to approve the goodwill/credit language and Olivia/ops (Dylan) to confirm the technical rollback window.

Sean Gallagher
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: proforma-service-credit-approval.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on June invoice and VAT treatment

Thanks Sean — approved. We will issue the credit memo for USD 4,320 as a goodwill/service adjustment and send the adjusted invoice (4872 v2) with the VAT reclassification to Helion. Billing to post the credit to their account and note the reason as "duplicate aggregation — system retry".

Dylan, please coordinate the postmortem and let Ops know this intersects with the aggregation worker rollout last month.

Target timeline: credit memo + adjusted invoice issued by EOD 2025-07-15; credit applied to account that same day.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@helion.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on June invoice and VAT treatment

Hi Elena — happy to confirm we completed the adjustment. Attached are: the credit memo (credit-memo-HLN-4872.pdf) and the adjusted invoice (adjusted-invoice-4872-v2.pdf). We applied a USD 4,320 credit to Helion's account and reissued the invoice with VAT shown as reverse-charge (no VAT collected).

A few notes:
- The credit appears as a negative line on your account and will offset the original invoice balance.
- We will not close the postmortem until Dylan confirms the fix; he will follow up on the technical details separately.
- If you need a signed statement for your local accounting team, we can route the credit memo through DocuSign (link below).

Please confirm receipt and whether you want the credit posted to your next invoice or to be returned as a refund.

Thanks for flagging this so we could resolve quickly.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
